title: The Burnt Cipher
author: Dominic Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Oyelaran, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
